title: Echoes Inside Rails
transcript: A rail can look smooth while damage is developing below its surface. In a training demonstration, we pushed a small trolley along a length of retired track. A tank on the trolley supplied water to help sound pass from the probe into the steel. We positioned a reference block beside the test rail and used it at the start of each session to check the instrument response. As the trolley moved, a wheel sensor recorded the distance travelled, letting us return to the position of an unusual echo. During the demonstration, the class found that passes made in opposite directions sometimes produced echoes of different strengths at the same spot. The orientation of a flaw can affect how much sound comes back. So a weak return from one direction needs to be interpreted alongside readings taken from other angles.

questions.prompt: Liquid supplied by the trolley to transmit sound into the steel: ____
questions.explanation: 小车上的储罐供水，帮助声波从探头传入钢轨。

questions.prompt: A reference ____ was used to check the instrument response.
questions.explanation: 每次实验开始时，研究人员用参考试块检查仪器响应。

questions.prompt: Distance was recorded by a wheel ____.
questions.explanation: 车轮传感器记录小车行进的距离，以便重新找到异常回波的位置。

questions.prompt: What sometimes happened when the trolley passed the same spot in opposite directions?
options: The recorded position of the spot changed.
The two passes gave equally strong returns.
The two passes gave returns of different strengths.
questions.answer: The two passes gave returns of different strengths.
questions.explanation: 同一位置在两个相反方向的检测中有时会产生强度不同的回波。

questions.prompt: How should a weak return from one direction be interpreted?
options: Compare it with readings from other angles.
Use the trolley speed to estimate the size of the flaw.
Give it the same weight as all stronger returns.
questions.answer: Compare it with readings from other angles.
questions.explanation: 缺陷的朝向会影响回波强度，因此应结合其他角度的读数判断。
